independence_statement: Saved before opening local spot, source, media or prior candidate records for these 25 names. Candidate selection used external discovery only.
method_limits: Coordinates are approximate discovery points and do not prove a launch.
Protected-area permission is unresolved unless explicitly sourced.
Full draft/cloud duplication access remained unavailable.

spots.name: Chalikounas, Corfu
spots.identity: The long sand strip beside Lake Korission, not the whole southwest Corfu coast.
spots.conditions: Regular afternoon northwesterly and shallow nearshore learning water; a school and rescue are documented.
spots.access_rules: Map the legal sport section against the lake/dune nature reserve and current bathing zones.
spots.trip_value: A distinctive sea-wetland setting with established daily use supports worth_trip after conservation correction.

spots.name: Devil's Bay / Paradise Beach, Karpathos
spots.identity: A strong-wind Afiartis bay used for international windsurf competition.
spots.conditions: Exceptionally reliable strong Meltemi and recorded competition conditions.
spots.access_rules: Retain strong-wind level, rescue and exact bay boundaries.
spots.trip_value: International competition history and exceptional wind place it above worth_trip.

spots.name: Fanes, Rhodes
spots.identity: Fanes' open west-coast beach outside its fishing harbour.
spots.conditions: Constant breeze, open rigging space and strong-wind exposure with rentals/services.
spots.access_rules: Keep clear of the fishing harbour and mark swim, launch and strong-wind sectors.
spots.trip_value: Defined dual-discipline beach, services and island setting support worth_trip.

spots.name: Kefalos Bay, Kos
spots.identity: The windsurf/wing bay stations, separate from nearby Kohilari kite and wave beaches.
spots.conditions: Accelerated Meltemi and local thermal produce very flat cross-offshore water, lighter mornings and strong afternoons.
spots.access_rules: Pin the rescue-covered station area and retain offshore-wind and level/time guidance.
spots.trip_value: Long records, high reliability, schools and condition variety support worth_trip.

spots.name: Nissakia / Agios Nikolaos, Artemida
spots.identity: The Nissakia club and adjacent Agios Nikolaos sport sectors east of Athens.
spots.conditions: Strong exposed northerlies, flat water downwind and bump-and-jump waves upwind; water becomes crowded.
spots.access_rules: Split ability sectors, confirm kite permission and attach rescue, swimmer and airport/harbour constraints.
spots.trip_value: Long-running clubs, competition use and easy access support worth_trip after exact-zone correction.

spots.name: Marmari, Kos
spots.identity: Marmari's long north-coast sand beach and its wind/kite club sectors.
spots.conditions: High wind probability, steady side-shore summer Meltemi and channel acceleration.
spots.access_rules: Pin the club/launch section and protect dunes, swimmers and nearby Alykes habitat.
spots.trip_value: Officially recognised hotspot, multiple clubs and family services support worth_trip.

spots.name: Marmari – Megali Ammos, Evia
spots.identity: Megali Ammos wind-sport beach in South Evia, not Marmari harbour.
spots.conditions: Regular northerlies, waves, sheltered Petalioi-side waters and strong channel currents.
spots.access_rules: Map the launch, currents, harbour/navigation separation and current operator/rescue coverage.
spots.trip_value: Distinct sand-spit landscape and established sport use support worth_trip after safety correction.

spots.name: Mikri Vigla, Naxos
spots.identity: Mikri Vigla's divided Parthena/Limanaki bay with discipline-specific sections.
spots.conditions: Side to side-onshore Meltemi May–October, sandy water, schools and rescue.
spots.access_rules: Preserve the north/south section split and current swimmer/launch corridors.
spots.trip_value: International meeting point, reliable wind and full services support worth_trip.

spots.name: Ftelia, Mykonos
spots.identity: The north-facing Ftelia bay, distinct from Kalafatis and other Mykonos wind beaches.
spots.conditions: Exposed northerly Meltemi creates a recognised windsurf setting; detailed hazards and active services remain open.
spots.access_rules: Pin the launch and document onshore strong-wind, wave, archaeological and bathing constraints.
spots.trip_value: National tourism identifies a windsurf paradise, supporting worth_trip after operational correction.

spots.name: Golden Beach, Paros
spots.identity: Chrysi Akti's long shallow windsurf beach, separate from Tserdakia/New Golden.
spots.conditions: Northerly Meltemi dominates summer; shallow water and schools serve all levels.
spots.access_rules: Keep the operational boundary with New Golden explicit and map schools/swimmers.
spots.trip_value: Paros travel value, reliable wind and mature services support worth_trip.

spots.name: New Golden Beach / Tserdakia, Paros
spots.identity: The stronger-wind Tserdakia competition beach, not generic Golden Beach.
spots.conditions: The island's strongest winds, speed/jump conditions and an official former PWA World Cup venue.
spots.access_rules: Retain expert wind, competition, rescue and beach-sector guidance.
spots.trip_value: PWA history, global athlete draw and exceptional reliability exceed worth_trip.

spots.name: Tsoukalia, Paros
spots.identity: Northeast Paros wave-oriented windsurf beach.
spots.conditions: N/NNE Meltemi is slightly weaker than southern Paros; open waves and a rocky reef zone require experience.
spots.access_rules: Mark reef/sandy entries, no-centre self-sufficiency, swimmers and strong-wind level.
spots.trip_value: A quieter, wave-focused alternative supports worth_trip after hazard and launch correction.

spots.name: Pounta, Paros
spots.identity: Pounta's kite beach on the narrow Paros–Antiparos channel.
spots.conditions: Constant steady side-shore Meltemi accelerated by the channel, with established schools.
spots.access_rules: Map launch/swim sectors and channel/boat traffic; do not confuse with Pounda Beach Club elsewhere.
spots.trip_value: World-renowned kite beach, services and inter-island setting support worth_trip.

spots.name: Ixia Bay, Rhodes
spots.identity: The Ixia windsurf centre strip on Rhodes' west coast.
spots.conditions: Strong April–October northwesterly Meltemi and wavy/choppy water; multiple centres operate.
spots.access_rules: Select a centre/launch and retain pebbly shorebreak, gust, swimmer and rescue guidance.
spots.trip_value: One of Rhodes' officially preferred windsurf areas with mature infrastructure supports worth_trip.

spots.name: Kokkari, Samos
spots.identity: Kokkari's north-facing pebbly beach and seasonal windsurf centre.
spots.conditions: Terrain-enhanced constant cross-onshore northerlies, with wave/chop and quickly deepening water.
spots.access_rules: Mark the supervised school section, pebble entry, swimmers, shorebreak and strong-wind limits.
spots.trip_value: Distinct terrain wind, school and Samos destination support worth_trip.

spots.name: Agios Georgios, Naxos
spots.identity: The southern windsurf end of Agios Georgios bay and its shallow lagoon area.
spots.conditions: Shallow calm lagoon enables beginner, speed, slalom and freestyle use under summer Meltemi.
spots.access_rules: Kites are prohibited near the airport; pin the windsurf corridor and reef/swimmer boundary.
spots.trip_value: Long-running clubs, friendly water and town access support worth_trip after exact-zone correction.

spots.name: Theologos, Rhodes
spots.identity: Theologos' separated windsurf and kite stations on Rhodes' west coast.
spots.conditions: About 20 kt side-onshore southwest wind from midday, April–November, with rescue.
spots.access_rules: Retain separated discipline zones, airport proximity, swimmer and stronger-gust guidance.
spots.trip_value: Reliable conditions, full services and broad-level suitability support worth_trip.

spots.name: Plaka, Naxos
spots.identity: The organised windsurf school section on long Plaka/Maragkas beach.
spots.conditions: Summer north Meltemi crosses a flat bay with wide sandy shallows and teaching for all levels.
spots.access_rules: Pin the school section and distinguish it from Agios Georgios and Mikri Vigla; map swimmers.
spots.trip_value: A long-running school and broad beach support worth_trip after identity correction.

spots.name: Laguna, Naxos
spots.identity: The shallow Laguna/Flisvos windsurf water immediately adjoining Agios Georgios.
spots.conditions: An internationally used shallow lagoon suited to beginner, slalom and freestyle sessions.
spots.access_rules: Kites are forbidden near the airport; determine whether this is one entry with Agios Georgios.
spots.trip_value: Strong travel value exists, but the candidate identity requires consolidation.

spots.name: Schinias, Marathon
spots.identity: The southern Schinias Bay wind-sport area inside a Natura 2000 national park.
spots.conditions: Established wind use and winter southerly kitesurfing on a long shallow sandy bay.
spots.access_rules: Current park permission, fire closures, vehicle access and exact launch sector require authority confirmation.
spots.trip_value: Nature and sport value are strong, but protected-area rules block confirmation.

spots.name: Anavyssos, Attica
spots.identity: Athens Riviera windsurf base with conditional south-wind kitesurfing.
spots.conditions: Flat/gusty local conditions; kitesurfing is specifically associated with southerly winds.
spots.access_rules: Pin the club launch and retain gust, wind-direction and bathing restrictions.
spots.trip_value: Useful regional access and training, but evidence does not show distinctive dedicated-trip value.

spots.name: Nea Iraklitsa – Alana
spots.identity: Alana beach windsurf candidate west of Kavala.
spots.conditions: Official tourism calls the large beach suitable because of local winds, but coarse climatology is light and general water sports dominate.
spots.access_rules: Confirm the exact wind window, operator status, launch and bathing corridor.
spots.trip_value: Insufficient evidence of reliability or specialist travel value beyond a regional activity beach.

spots.name: Paliouri / Chrouso, Halkidiki
spots.identity: Popular shallow resort beach with generic water-sports marketing.
spots.conditions: Official sources establish beach services but not recurring windsurf use or a specialist launch.
spots.access_rules: Do not infer windsurf suitability from generic motorised water sports.
spots.trip_value: Insufficient discipline-specific evidence.

spots.name: Lake Volvi
spots.identity: Protected lake windsurf destination whose exact southern-shore launch remains open.
spots.conditions: Rentina-strait winds create waves and draw windsurfers nationally.
spots.access_rules: Pin a legal launch and confirm Ramsar/Natura permission, wildlife seasons and rescue.
spots.trip_value: Rare inland wave/wind character and national draw support worth_trip after protected-area correction.

spots.name: Lake Vegoritida
spots.identity: Large alpine lake with sailing/canoe use but no verified windsurf scene.
spots.conditions: Official tourism supports sailing and general activity; available coarse wind means are light.
spots.access_rules: A current windsurf operator, usable wind window, legal launch and rescue are unproven.
spots.trip_value: Scenic and sailing value do not establish a windsurf trip destination.
